Game Overview

At its heart, Ice Cream Truck is a puzzle game about "Become a master of sweet creation in Ice Cream Truck. Merge identical scoops for upgraded cones, boosting your earnings as you serve excited kids. Enjoy vibrant graphics while strategically combining flavors to maximize rewards before your board fills up. Think fast and serve smart in this delightful puzzle adventure!"

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Ice Cream Truck is easy to pick up. "Become a master of sweet creation in Ice Cream Truck!
